item.title: Aging With an Emperador
item.description: Last weekend I got together with a bunch of high school friends. I hadn’t seen some of them in over 30 years, but conversation was easy and our shared memories and “exploits” led to some good laughs. We all sat around the fire pit with wild eyes! I suppose from the outside most of us are simple vestiges of what we once were, but on the whole we were all talking about current passions and endeavors.
